messages:
maria: paging: multiple customer reports of 5xxs and timeouts for inference in east-us-2; metrics show egress token success dropping across two AZs. incident-bot severity: P1. @oncall-bot please route to oncall.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2912345678 — egress blackhole / NAT rebind suspected. Paging primary oncall: @maria.
alex: seeing ~30% of requests failing with connection reset on hosts behind private subnets. tcpdump shows SYNs leaving but no replies. only affects east-us-2a and east-us-2b.
sre_maya: getting VPC flow logs — a bunch of rejected egress to 0.0.0.0/0 from private-subnet-3 and private-subnet-7 starting 2912345600. Possible route table change. any terraform deploys around 2912345500-2912345600?
shaun: I pushed a small terraform hopfix to user-vpc module ~2912345555 to standardize route table associations across AZs. I did not modify NAT ids, only associations. plan looked fine but will grab the plan output.
shaun: >>>

```
# terraform apply output
module.vpc.aws_route_table_association.private[1]: update in-place
  route_table_id: "rtb-aaa" => "rtb-bbb"
``` 
shaun: after apply I saw more logs of route table changes. I thought it only touched assoc, not routes.
ops-bot: Alert: NAT gateway nat-03b4 became UNAVAILABLE in east-us-2b at 2912345620. Failover attempt to nat-02a returned no packets for whole AZ.
maria: quick check: aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0abc Name=association.subnet-id,Values=subnet-priv-3
maria: output: `0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-03b4` for subnet-priv-3, but route table rtb-bbb was recently applied and has `0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-9999` (stale/out-of-az). That explains blackhole.
alex: nat-9999 is a decommissioned placeholder ID from an older account import. looks like assoc swapped to a route table with wrong default route.
sre_maya: mitigation options: 1) re-associate subnets back to rtb-aaa that has healthy NATs, 2) update route in rtb-bbb to point to nat-02a (in correct AZ), 3) add temporary internet gateway route for affected subnets while we fix NAT.
maria: doing option 1 now: re-associating subnet-priv-3 -> rtb-aaa. `aws ec2 associate-route-table --subnet-id subnet-priv-3 --route-table-id rtb-aaa` (running)
ops-bot: Config change detected: route-table-association changed for subnet-priv-3 at 2912345665.
shaun: rollback of my association change in terraform in progress. creating empty commit to revert.
maria: check: flows look better for subnet-priv-3, packets leaving and responses returning. error rate for customers impacted down from 28% -> 4% in 5m. continuing reassociation for subnet-priv-7.
eng_tessa: I updated status page draft: "Partial egress disruption in east-us-2 affecting inference endpoints; mitigation in progress." @lina-cs can you coordinate customer comms?
lina-cs: on it. I've posted to customers with active incidents, offering throttled retries and workaround to route to eu-west while we stabilize.
sre_maya: note: private hosted zone TTL for internal resolver is 10s; but we also saw a stale private-dns record pointing some replicas to wrong ENI which may have amplified cross-AZ traffic to NAT-9999. need to check Route53 private-zone changes.
alex: searching CloudTrail: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AssociateRouteTable` shows shaun's apply at 2912345555. Also found a `ChangeResourceRecordSets` event at 2912345599 by platform-automation altering a service discovery record TTL to 300 -> 10.
shaun: the terraform module had a default RT association loop — the plan didn't flag that a different rtb object (rtb-bbb) has an outdated route. my bad, shifting to hotfix.
maria: can we temporarily enable SNAT on gateways? not possible quickly. continuing re-associations and patching rtb-bbb route to nat-02a. applying route update now: `aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-bbb --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --gateway-id nat-02a` (applied)
ops-bot: Route replaced in rtb-bbb at 2912345690.
maria: traffic recovery trending good across both AZs now, overall error rate down to ~1.2%.
oncall-bot: Incident update: mitigation applied, customer impact reduced. Next: run a controlled terraform plan to reconcile associations and pin rtb routes to correct nat IDs. RCA task created: RCA-2912345678.
shaun: going to add guard in module to prevent route-table object reuse across AZs and add automated plan checks comparing route targets with NAT availability.
eng_tessa: heads-up we should schedule a short maintenance window to reapply corrected IaC after hours; need SRE + Platform signoff.
lina-cs: customers notified. one enterprise reported brief SLA breach; CS preparing credit calculation.
sre_maya: handoff: @maria holding for 30 mins to monitor, then handing to day oncall @alex at 2912345725. Please follow runbook egress-mitigation-2024.
maria: taking oncall watch and will hand off at 2912345725. thanks team. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Handoff logged: from maria -> alex at 2912345729.
maria: post-incident immediate actions: 1) lock terraform module changes with policy, 2) verify all rtb objects have correct 0.0.0.0/0 target, 3) add a monitoring alert for route-target mismatch vs NAT health. filing followups in INC-2912345678.
shaun: apologies for the churn. I'll open a PR with tests and notify infra reviewers.
eng_tessa: postmortem owner: shaun; SLO impact summary will be computed by Product Ops. Next update in #postmortems in 24h."
